svg.aria-label: I take messy operations in healthcare, education, ERP and customer support and get them live. AI only comes in when it cuts time or risk. Right now I'm a full stack developer at PVT Software in Vitória, Brazil. My projects, with the code and the decisions behind each one, are on my portfolio.
